scope: Original proposal PDFs only; reviewer reports, standalone CVs/biosketches, and standalone administrative tables are not separate proposals.
full_draft_scope: Preserves the existing field convention: complete main narrative from Introduction through resources and timeline, including in-body tables and figure captions. Title, contacts, and abstract remain in their existing fields; bibliography is in references. Supplementary dataset/participant tables and CVs are excluded except dataset rows explicitly cited as references. Captions/tables that interrupt wrapped paragraphs are retained after the narrative. Diagram artwork is not represented in this text field.
method: Poppler pdftotext layout and bounding-box extraction; rendered main pages visually inspected; manual correction of image-only timelines and malformed mathematical text layers. Whitespace, common ligatures, wrapped URLs and line-break hyphenation normalized. No citation metadata was fetched or invented. Leading numeric reference labels removed; citation text and source order preserved.
